name: pi-*0.6 / RECAP
summary: RECAP (RL with Experience and Corrections via Advantage-conditioned Policies) post-trains a pi-0.6 VLA on its own deployment data. A value function trained on real rollouts scores each action's advantage, the policy is conditioned on that advantage so it can be steered toward high-value behavior at inference, and teleoperators intervene on failures to supply corrective data. Reported results include multi-hour espresso-machine operation and box assembly at around double the baseline throughput.
innovation: Advantage-conditioned training folds RL value estimates into a generative VLA without unstable actor-critic loops.
Treats teleoperator interventions as a first-class supervision channel, closing a deploy-correct-retrain loop.
matters: A concrete answer to 'what comes after imitation' for large VLAs: learning from the robot's own experience.
limits: Announced mainly via company blog and report; independent reproduction is limited. Verify before citing.
lineage: pi-0.6 post-trained with an RL procedure descended from offline RL and human-in-the-loop RL.
